long_description:
Join Avril, Yoga Teacher, Reiki Master and Goth acolyte, in a Slow Flow Yoga Class accompanied by the classic, dark stylings of Sisters of Mercy, Boy Harsher, The Cure, Nick Cave and many more bands old and new

Come dressed to move and flow as a dark romantic, a Goth or in your witchy chic garb. Make sure you’re comfortable enough to move, flow and enjoy a hauntingly delicious corpse pose. For just one night, embrace your inner shadow, let it out, let it flow and let it breathe. 

All levels are welcome!

$22 per person

Bring your yoga mat. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Cleveland, Workshops in Cleveland.
